meta.title: Taẓuri d lesnaɛa tipuniyen — izran, ucenfiṛen, lǥawahar, djaǧ, idrimen
meta.desc: Taẓuri n Qarṭaǧ, tiɣawsiwin ɣef tiɣawsiwin : izran, lkafen, ucenfiṛen, lǥawahar, ticenfiṛin n djaǧ, tasekkurt, idrimen ; ixxamen n Kerkouane, lmuzayik tipuniyen, imḍalen, akked isinagen anida ara ten-twalim.
hero.title: Taẓuri d lesnaɛa tipuniyen
hero.lede: Igrikiyen ḥeqqṛen « ticcetlin » tifiniqiyin. Ikecfan sbeggnen-d ayen-nniḍen : lxiwanat yemsɛanaden, i yesdukklen lemtul icerqiyen, timiṣriyen d tigrikiyen akked ismenyafen ifrikiyen.
hero.caption: Acenfiṛ yettemcaben, talaḥt, Asinag agraɣlan n Bardo
cab.title: Lxiwan apuni deg tnaɛc n tɣawsiwin
cab.intro: Aṭas n ayen i nessen yekka-d seg yimḍalen, yettwakecfen seg lqern wis 19 : ifecka n yimḍalen sbeggnen-d lesnaɛa yimɛamren yemsɛanaden (Amadasi Guzzo).
items.stelae.name: Izran d lkafen
items.stelae.alt: Azru apuni ițwaɣzan s ucaraf n Tanit
items.stelae.text: Ttwagezmen zik deg uẓru arqaq, imbeɛd deg wezru n lǥir, ɛemmṛen s lemtul n lǥehd agrikan. « Acaraf n Tanit » yettwafreq seg lqern wis 5–4 ; ɣilen zik d win n ugmur kan, ass-a ufan-t daɣen ɣer Ccerq.
items.stelae.mat: Azru arqaq, imbeɛd azru n lǥir
items.masks.name: Ucenfiṛen yettemcaben
items.masks.text: Tiɣrad yeɣẓan, imi yettwaẓẓan, kra n tikwal lemtul n tjeɣrit : ucenfiṛen-agi, ahat d-kkan seg Ccerq, țwaseklaqen iwakken ad sfeḍen leǥnun.
items.masks.date: Tagara n lqern wis 7 – lqern wis 6 send Ɛisa
items.jewels.alt: Tiqenniḍent n ddheb tipuniyen, aẓekka n Puig des Molins di Ibiza
items.jewels.name: Lǥawahar
items.jewels.text: Timeqyasin iẓayen ɛemmṛen, tixetmin, tiqenniḍent n imeẓẓuɣen d tnzert (nezem), ikufan n ucenfiṛen : lɣela i d-yewrit seg Ccerq, i yeḥeqqṛen yimeskaren iqdimen.
items.coins.name: Idrimen
items.coins.alt: Ṛebɛ n ssekel aqarṭaǧi, aqerru n Tanit d uɣyul
items.coins.text: Aṭas n lweqt, asɣaṛ s ṣṣayeb neɣ s umsebdal. Idrimen imezwura ttwagen di Sicile (Motyé, Palerme) i uxleṣ n yiɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen ; Qarṭaǧ teldi lxiwanat-ines kan deg ammas n lqern wis 4. Lemtul : aqerru n tmeṭṭut i d-yekkan seg idrimen n Syracuse n Évainète, aɣyul, tazdayt (Dridi).
items.sarco.alt: Lkafen n uzru n wergaz d tmeṭṭut, aẓekka n Sainte-Monique di Qarṭaǧ
items.sarco.cap: Qarṭaǧ, lqern wis 4–3 · Asinag n Louvre
items.sarco.name: Lkafen
items.sarco.text: Lemtel afiniqi n welɣem n wemdan yettbeddel deg ugmur. Deg lqern wis 4, aɣummu yesɛa tugna n yemmuten : « akahin » yeẓẓuɣuṛ s ufus ayeffus, « takahint » teṭṭef tatbirt ; sin-nsen ṭṭfen akufi n lebxur.
items.sarco.mat: Azru n lmermer d lǥir yettwaxedmen
items.figs.name: Tugniwin d lemtul imeẓyanen
items.figs.alt: Baal Hammon yeqqim ɣef usgeld, talaḥt n Thinissut
items.figs.text: Aɣemmu n uwjeh n telɣa timiṣrit, imbeɛd tagrikit seg lqern wis 6, tugniwin s tbendayer : lesnaɛa n ucudu teẓẓa seg Tafrikt armi d Jzayer Baléares. Teqqim ddren mbeɛd aɣelli n Qarṭaǧ, am deg umḍiq aqeddas n Thinissut (Ras Addar).
items.figs.date: Lqern wis 6 send Ɛisa – lqern wis 1 mbeɛd Ɛisa
items.glass.alt: Krad n ucenfiṛen n djaǧ : iqerra s ttawt, allen tiwessaren
items.glass.name: Ucenfiṛen n djaǧ
items.glass.text: Pline yeqqar-d belli Ifiniqiyen i d-isnulfan djaǧ ; ɛawanen s telqey ad t-ssefreqen s lmeqyas ameqqran. Lɛalama tapunit : iqerra n yemdanen imeẓyanen n djaǧ yemẓaɛẓaɛen, yettwasersen ɣef timeqyasin n tfendasin.
items.glass.date: S telqey lqern wis 4 – 3 send Ɛisa
items.razors.alt: Krad n tsekkurin tipuniyen n ṣṣfeṛ, afus-nsent d aqerru n ufrux
items.razors.name: Tisekkurin
items.razors.text: Llant aṭas deg yimḍalen mbeɛd lqern wis 7, qqnent ɣer tsfeḍt n yemmuten sɛant azal n usentem (Lancel). Seg lqern wis 5, ttwagezment s lemtul timiṣriyin neɣ tigéiyin, kra n tikwal deg snat n tama.
items.ceramics.alt: Akufi apuni n talaḥt, yettwaceṭṭḥen s snat n walen tiwessaren
items.ceramics.name: Lfexxaṛ d ikufan n zzit
items.ceramics.text: Lǥab n lmakla, ikufan n zzit s telɣa yettwasnan, ikufan n warraw, « tiweslatin n lǥebna » (Lancel), ula d tugna n ukufi n tabuna i d-yettwafen deg weẓekka.
items.ceramics.date: Akk lweqt ; lemtul igrikiyen seg lqern wis 3
items.ceramics.use: Tudert n wass ɣer wass, ifecka n yimḍalen
items.amulets.alt: Tiqenniḍent n usentem timiṣriyin d tiqarṭaǧiyin, gar-asent acaraf n Tanit n ṣṣfeṛ
items.amulets.name: Lxwatem n usentem
items.amulets.text: S telqey deg yimḍalen n tilawin d warraw. Ttwakecment seg Maṣer neɣ ttwaxedment din, sbeggnent Bès, Horus neɣ Til Oudjat.
items.seals.alt: Takbert n uẓru azegzaw yettwagezmen s Héraclès, ɣef texxamt n ddheb
items.seals.cap: Agriko-afiniqi, tagara n lqern wis 6 · Walters Art Museum
items.seals.name: Tixxamin-ṭṭwabeε d tkebraṛ
items.seals.text: Ttwagezment s wawal n ukbaṛ deg wammas, s telqey ttwakecment seg lxiwanat timiṣriyin neɣ tifiniqiyin. Mbeɛd ammas n lqern wis 4, lgezmat ɣef djaǧ, idrusen akteṛ, zemrent ad sbeggnent lxiwanat timasayin.
items.seals.date: Akk lweqt ; tedderri mbeɛd 350 send Ɛisa
items.ivory.alt: Afus n lemri s uɣes n ulfil d tḥuṛiyin ttwagezment s uɣes n ulfil d yiɣsan
items.ivory.name: Aɣes n ulfil d yiɣsan ittwagezmen
items.ivory.text: Tḥuṛiyin timeẓyanin ittwagezment s lemtul icerqiyen neɣ imiṣriyen ; iɣsan ttɛawaden ddaw n uɣes n ulfil, d imerẕi aṭas. Aɣes n ulfil war taẓuri i d-yettwafen deg yimukan-nni yesken-d lxiwanat imasayen.
archi.title: Ixxamen, lǥab akked yimḍalen
archi.intro: Drus n ixxamen ipuniyen i yeqqimen bedden : aṭas n wayen i nessen yeqqar-d deg lqaɛa, di Kerkouane akked ɣef idurar n Byrsa.
archi.kerkAlt: Ixxamen ipuniyen n Kerkouane, Ras Addar
archi.houses.title: Tamdint s tedbalin
archi.houses.p1: Iberdan iwεren, tigejda yemsaɛdalen : Kerkouane, am yigrawen « Magun » akked « Hanibal » n Qarṭaǧ, yeḍfeṛ aɣawas awraman. Yal axxam yesɛa ammas-is, lǥab-is : aman d lxedma tudmawant.
archi.houses.p2: Ufan-d dinna aṭas n tɣawsiwin n uɣessel. Kra n ixxamen ɛemmṛen akteṛ, am wexxam n icudiwen n webrid n Apotropaion. I M'hamed Hassine Fantar, d lemtel acerqi yettwasnjam i tẓgi talibikit.
archi.houses.tags.0: Tagara n lqern wis 4 – tazwart n lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa
archi.byrsa.title: Ixxamen s iḥedrayen
archi.byrsa.p1: Ɣef tama n Byrsa, tawwurt tuεrit teldi ɣef ubrid iɣezfen i yeddan ɣer ammas yesɛan laḥfuṛ. Zdat, taxxamt tezmer ad tili d lmaɣaza ; tsidast tali ɣer iḥedrayen.
archi.byrsa.p2: Appien yeḥka-d ɣef ixxamen n sețța iḥedrayen. Tasenfarrut tesken-d aṭas n iḥedrayen, maca mačči amḍan-nsen.
archi.byrsa.alt: Lxrab n ugraw apuni n Byrsa, Qarṭaǧ
archi.byrsa.caption: Agraw apuni n Byrsa, lqern wis 2 send Ɛisa
archi.pav.title: Acaraf n Tanit deg lǥab
archi.pav.p1: Iqeṭṭuɛen n uẓru d lmermer deg lmertel azeggaɣ : lǥab-agi, i d-yettwafen di Kerkouane akked ɣef tama n ugafa n Byrsa, ɛemmṛen kra n tikwal s ucaraf n Tanit.
archi.pav.p2: Yettwafen azemz-nsen ɣer lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa, sḥettmen ad nebdel tikti i d-yeqqaren belli lmuzayik telul-d di Tagrikt.
archi.pav.svgLabel: Tugna : acaraf n Tanit (azellaw, tagejdit, akradi) ɣef lǥab n lmertel azeggaɣ ɛemmṛen s tgezdal
archi.infl.title: Maṣer, Tagrikt, Tafrikt
archi.infl.rows.0.val: I zzman aqdim akteṛ : taneγnit s laxlal, udmawen n lǥwameε imeẓyanen s uẓellaw n yiṭij akked uṛaεi ɣef yizran (Lancel).
archi.infl.rows.1.val: Imbeεd : tigejdal n uẓru arqaq n El Haouaria yettwasnan, ddabex ionique (naïskos n Thuburbo Majus, di Bardo) akked dorique (Byrsa).
archi.infl.rows.2.val: Opus africanum — lḥiṭan s izran ibeddan — yeḍhiṛ-d di Kerkouane, yeqqim ddren deg zzman aṛumani, armi d Capitole n Dougga.
necro.title: Imḍalen
necro.alt: Aẓekka apuni n Puig des Molins, Ibiza
necro.caption: Aẓekka n Puig des Molins, Ibiza
necro.rows.0.val: Deg leqwas ɣef tama n temdint : abrid-nsen yeǧǧa-d ad ttwafent tilisa n Qarṭaǧ tapunit (Picard).
necro.rows.1.val: Ttwagezmen deg uẓru : lbir usrid, lbir s texxamin yemdewwiren, neɣ tsidast tṛuḥu ɣer lbir.
necro.rows.2.val: Lmayet s welɣem yezga ; aserɣ ineggez fell-as deg kra n izemzan, akken i d-tesken Puig des Molins.
necro.rows.3.val: Lfexxaṛ, lǥawahar, lxwatem, aẓeggaɣ (idammen, tudert), timellalin n ṣṣerdun ittwaceṭṭḥen (talalit tamaynut), ikufan imeẓyanen n talaḥt.
necro.rows.4.val: Imḍalen yettwaceṭṭḥen n Djebel Mlezza (Ras Addar) ; di Kerkouane, lkafi n weɣyul i yeqqimen s wayen ur yettwarawen ara.
necro.quote: « I wgdud-agi n imaẓlaḥ, Tamdint n igenni d lmersa taneggarut anda ara qqimen. »
necro.cite: François Decret, Carthage ou l'empire de la mer (1977)
mus.title: Anida ara twalim taẓuri tapunit
mus.intro: Lxiwanat timeqqranin llant di Tunes akked Qarṭaǧ ; wiyaḍ ferqen seg Londres armi d Madrid, s lemqader n ikecfan d lexrawat n lqern wis 19.
mus.items.carthage.name: Asinag agraɣlan n Qarṭaǧ
mus.items.carthage.alt: « Tamɣart n Qarṭaǧ », lmuzayik n zzman aqdim aneggaru
mus.items.carthage.text: Lkafen n ukahin akked tkahint, lǥawahar, ikufan n zzit, djaǧ, tugna n ukufi n tabuna — qrib n ugraw apuni. (Tugna : « Tamɣart n Qarṭaǧ », lmuzayik n zzman aneggaru aṭas mbeɛd.)
mus.items.bardo.name: Asinag agraɣlan n Bardo
mus.items.bardo.alt: Tayillut s uqerru n izem n Thinissut, talaḥt
mus.items.bardo.text: Taneddawt tapunit : izran n tofet, acenfiṛ yettemcaben n tagara n lqern wis 6, tugniwin n Thinissut (Baal Hammon, tayillut s uqerru n izem), lxwatem akked lǥawahar, naïskos n Thuburbo Majus.
mus.items.kerkouane.name: Amḍiq d usinag n Kerkouane
mus.items.kerkouane.text: Tamdint tapunit s yiman-is, akked usinag amecṭuḥ i d-yesbeggnen ifecka-ines : lfexxaṛ, lǥawahar, tiɣawsiwin n yimḍalen.
mus.items.louvre.name: Asinag n Louvre
mus.items.louvre.text: Tiɣawsiwin n Ccerq aqdim : acenfiṛ n Qarṭaǧ (tagara n lqern wis 7 – tazwart n lqern wis 6), tugniwin timiṣriyin, lkafen n Rabs, aqerru ucudden n djaǧ, izran s ucaraf n Tanit.
mus.items.bm.name: British Museum
mus.items.bm.text: Tira s snat n tutlayin, talibikit d tapunit, n uẓekka n Dougga, akked agar n yidrimen iqarṭaǧiyen, gar-asen ssekel n At Barka s ulfil.
mus.elsewhere.title: Hispanya, Sicile, Sardaigne

mus.elsewhere.rows.1.val: Asinag d weẓekka n Puig des Molins : tugniwin, iqbac n zzit, imḍalen s lebyuṛ.
mus.elsewhere.rows.2.val: Asinag Antonino-Salinas : lkafi n welɣem n wemdan n lqern wis 5, ikufan ipuniyen n zzit.
